name: document_mentions_conn_loss_lq1696_20261109
comment: 2026-11-09 — LQ-20261107-1696: a dropped DB session must not kill the hourly
document-mentions-backfill lane, and if it cannot be recovered the lane must
exit 69 so transient-1-ingest's one retry actually happens.
The live failures replayed here: slots 0825/0925/1025 ET on 2026-11-09 each
died with 'psycopg2.OperationalError: SSL connection has been closed
unexpectedly' inside document_mentions._conflict_target, exited 1, and were
graded terminal on attempt 1 of 2 — three dead letters, then the breaker.
test_pg_reconnect.py rides with it because the wrapper and its new
module-level is_connection_loss() are the same decision seen from two sides:
the proxy retries the lost statement, the script maps an unrecoverable loss
to the exit code the retry policy reads. A change to one that breaks the other
must go red in one run.
test_document_mentions.py rides with it because persist() is the transaction
boundary the retry depends on: its first statement after the read commit is
the one the proxy can replay, so the conflict-target probe and the write path
